purpose: Import longitudinal worker-performance evidence into Helix without turning worker count, self-scoring, provider failures, or prompt changes into unsupported hiring or innovation claims.

score_semantics.quality: How well the worker performed its assigned contract under the fixed review rubric. This is not causal system value.
score_semantics.marginal_system_value: Signed full-system outcome minus matched full-minus-worker outcome. Null until a performance-valid ablation.
score_semantics.outcome_leverage: Normalized decision/artifact impact attributable to the worker under the matched ablation contract. Null until a performance-valid ablation.
score_semantics.legacy_benefit: May be retained as source telemetry but must not be relabeled as marginal system value.

state_projection.BASELINE_READY: Run a matched template delta with frozen topology/provider/rubric.
state_projection.PROVIDER_BLOCKED: Repeat the exact matched turn only after a healthy provider probe; do not mutate worker templates.
state_projection.DELTA_MEASURED: Run worker ablations before topology compression or specialization.
state_projection.CAUSAL_TOPOLOGY_READY: Derive a mission-family-specific learned topology preset from completed ablations.

truth_boundary: Helix consumes worker-science receipts as experimental control evidence. A worker-quality improvement does not prove causal system value; a topology is not learned until matched ablations support it; a topology learned for one mission family is not presumed optimal for another.
